Option 1: "با بدان کم نشین که صحبت بد - گر چه پاکی تو را پلید کند". Rough: "Sit not with that few [bad] [people] because conversation is bad - even though your purity will make it vile." Actually "با بدان کم نشین که صحبت بد" means "Do not sit with those few [bad] people because their talk is bad." "گر چه پاکی تو را پلید کند" means "Even though your purity will make it vile." So concept: warning against bad company, even if you are pure.

Option 2: "حسد آنجا که آتش افروزد - خرمن عقل و عافیت سوزند". "Envy there where fire is lit - the grain of wisdom and health burn." So concept: envy is destructive, burning wisdom and health.

Option 3: "گر ما می و معشوق گزیدیم چه باک - چون عاقبت کار چنین خواهد بود". "If we choose wine and beloved, why fear - because the outcome of such work will be." So concept: indulgence in wine and beloved, no fear because outcome is known? It's about pleasure, maybe acceptance.

Option 4: "که چون بدگهر پرورم الجرم - خیــــانــــت روا داردم در حـــــرم". "Because when I raise a bad child, the crime - I have given you the lie in the heat." Hard to parse. Might be about raising a bad child, crime, lying. Could be about hypocrisy.

We need to find which one has a different concept/message from others. Let's see themes: 1: warning against bad company. 2: envy destructive. 3: indulgence in wine and beloved. 4: raising bad child, crime, lying. So 3 is about pleasure, others about negative aspects? 1 and 2 are warnings about negative influences. 4 is about raising a bad child, crime, lying. 3 is about indulgence. So 3 is different? But 4 also negative. 3 is positive? Actually 3 says "If we choose wine and beloved, why fear - because the outcome will be." It's about not fearing indulgence. So it's a different concept: it's about pleasure, not warning. So answer likely 3.

But let's double-check 4: "که چون بدگهر پرورم الجرم - خیــــانــــت روا داردم در حـــــرم". Might be about raising a bad child, crime, lying. It's about moral responsibility. So negative. So 3 is the outlier.

Thus answer: 3.
